scope: Owned standalone production-entry harness; chrome is harness HTML, not integrated Player/ImmersiveMode. No main/shared routing changes.
limitations: SwiftShader software GPU; no physical touch device or sustained hardware performance certification.
Fence is an observation of the existing command stream, not a GPU timer or measured per-frame GPU cost.
render-js-return duration includes synchronous driver/compiler stalls; it is not pure JavaScript CPU time.
Configured shared-host retention is 5000 ms; disposal entry/exit and actual context loss are separate measured events.

targetCompatibility.note: Normal capability-selected target path and actual framebuffer checks.

trustedDirectRootMouseDrag.method: Native mouse with sibling overlay absent; harness control panel remains visible, so this is not a full-app hidden-chrome claim.

chromeControlSuppression.method: Native browser clicks on harness Play, overlay button and Pause; scene emitted no interaction

syntheticCancellationEdges.method: Explicitly synthetic DOM PointerEvents and window blur in one task through real production handlers; not native device input.

touch.method: Playwright touchscreen.tap, trusted browser emulated touch; not synthetic DOM dispatch or physical hardware

postInteractionRendered.note: At least two genuine animation submissions after the trusted touch; bounded test burst, not continuous performance evidence.

syntheticHidden.method: Synthetic document.hidden override+visibilitychange; real background-tab behavior unrun

captures.captureMethod: Playwright native full viewport PNG via Chromium surface; unmodified HTML+WebGL composition
Playwright native full viewport PNG via Chromium surface; unmodified HTML+WebGL composition

warnings: THREE.WebGLShadowMap: PCFSoftShadowMap has been removed. Using PCFShadowMap instead.
unrun: Physical hardware touch; true operating-system background/foreground; sustained GPU throughput; full-app production chrome.
